name: Purification
overview: Scripture reveals purification as a vital practice for God's people, involving both physical and spiritual cleansing. For example, Jacob instructed his household to remove foreign gods and cleanse themselves, including changing garments, emphasizing holiness (Genesis 35:2). At Mount Sinai, God commanded the Israelites to sanctify themselves by washing their clothes and abstaining from sexual relations in preparation for His presence (Exodus 19:10, 14-15). Additionally, purification involved ceremonial acts such as offering sacrifices and sprinkling blood on the altar, symbolizing atonement and dedication to God (Exodus 24:5-6). These passages highlight purification as essential for approaching God in holiness and obedience.
